name: @invest/worker
description: Cloudflare Worker — API・画面・日次パイプライン

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute invest-db --local --file=../../migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute invest-db --local --file=../../migrations/0002_waitlist.sql && wrangler d1 execute invest-db --local --file=../../migrations/0003_quotes.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute invest-db --remote --env production --file=../../migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute invest-db --remote --env production --file=../../migrations/0002_waitlist.sql && wrangler d1 execute invest-db --remote --env production --file=../../migrations/0003_quotes.sql
scripts.waitlist: wrangler d1 execute invest-db --remote --env production --command "SELECT email, created_at, consented_at, status FROM waitlist ORDER BY created_at DESC"
